record.question: The ancient temple was a place of veneration for people who sought spiritual guidance. Choose the word which best expresses the opposite meaning of the bold word 'veneration':
record.explanation: Answer A: Sacrilege. “Sacrilege” is an irreverent violation of something sacred, opposite the reverence expressed by “veneration.” Independent check: Veneration is deep respect; sacrilege is an act that violates or shows disrespect for something sacred, the closest opposite offered. Reference: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/veneration; https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/sacrilege. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
